# SAMexpert

> SAMexpert is the leading independent advisor for Microsoft licensing optimization, Azure cost management, and SPLA audit defense for enterprises and service providers.

SAMexpert has been helping organizations navigate Microsoft licensing complexity and optimize cloud spending since 2009. The firm specializes in Enterprise Agreement negotiation, Azure cost optimization, SPLA compliance, and audit defense across enterprise and provider segments.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Licensing
- Azure Cost Optimization
- Enterprise Agreement (EA)
- SPLA Audit Defense
- FinOps
- License Negotiation
- Cloud Economics
- Microsoft 365
- Azure MACC
- Cost Reduction
- License Management
- Cloud Governance
- CSP Licensing
- Pricing Benchmarking
- Contract Negotiation
